subject: Tenant access: admin stewardship, API token plan & invite timeline
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New tenant: Lumina Health - initial access and admin list

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier. We're ready to get our Redwood workspace provisioned for our pilot. High-level ask:

- Create an org/tenant for "Lumina Health - Pilot"
- Seed 2 admin users and 5 dev seats
- Provide API key guidance and recommended project structure
- Share an invite cadence and expected SSO/KMS items

I'll attach a short org diagram and a draft admin list for now. Our IT lead (Linus Park) will take point on provisioning details.

Would love a kickoff window for tomorrow morning PST. Also cc'ing Soojin and Jonas for implementation and network questions.

Best,
Claire

--
Claire Huang
Director, Data & AI
Lumina Health
Attachments: lumina-org-diagram.pdf (stub), lumina-admin-draft.csv (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New tenant: Lumina Health - initial access and admin list

Claire — thanks, this is perfect. Proposed plan below (aimed at minimizing friction while keeping security controls):

1) Provisioning & roles (Day 0)
   - Create tenant: "Lumina Health - Pilot"
   - Seed two admin accounts: Primary Admin (Claire) + IT Admin (Linus)
   - Create one "Platform Admin" service account for CI/cd (scoped key)

2) API keys & projects
   - Recommend two projects: "pilot-ingest" (dev) and "pilot-serve" (prod-sim)
   - We will generate an initial scoped API key for "pilot-ingest" with token rotation guidance in the invite template (see attached)

3) Invite cadence & timeline
   - Today: finalize admin emails and confirm SSO/KMS details
   - Tomorrow 09:00-09:45 PST: 30m kickoff (exec/IT + implementation + infra)
   - Day+1: seed keys, invite users, handoff to CS for health checks

4) Security items
   - If you want KMS integration from day one, we need the KMS principal and key alias before seeding keys. Otherwise we will store keys in customer-managed KMS on day 2.

Attached: redwood-invite-template.docx, role-matrix.xlsx — both are stubs with the fields we use to seed invites.

Action items for Claire/Lumina before kickoff:
- Confirm primary admin email and IT admin email (who will receive admin invites)
- Decide whether to enable SSO now or after initial key seeding
- Confirm preferred kickoff time (tomorrow morning PST suggested)

I'll coordinate the tenant creation and key seeding once we have the admin emails. Soojin will lead the implementation tasks after tenant creation and Jonas will help with network/K8s-level questions if needed.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-invite-template.docx (stub), role-matrix.xlsx (stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-16T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New tenant: Lumina Health - initial access and admin list

Looping in a quick implementation checklist so Ben's plan maps to our runbook:

- Pre-kickoff (today):
  • Validate admin emails (Claire, Linus) — Ben, ping us once confirmed
  • Confirm whether Lumina wants SSO (SAML) setup now — if yes, we need metadata and ACS URL beforehand

- Kickoff (tomorrow 09:00 PST):
  • Tenant creation confirmation
  • Walk through role-matrix (we'll screen-share the spreadsheet)
  • Generate the scoped API key for pilot-ingest and show token rotation flow

- Post-kickoff (Day+1):
  • Seed dev seats and verify invite flows
  • Optional: KMS binding (if Lumina supplies principals) — target Day+2

Jonas — can you pre-validate the network egress rules we usually include for clustering (outbound to model artifact repo + telemetry endpoints)? If Lumina's networking team needs a CIDR allowlist, we should surface that in the kickoff invite.

I'll prepare the invite template and role guidance so Ben can send the invites immediately after kickoff.

— Soojin
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
Internal notes: Attach role-matrix.xlsx (finalized copy)

From: Linus Park <linus@luminahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-16T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New tenant: Lumina Health - initial access and admin list

Thanks — confirming admin emails and the kickoff:

Primary Admin: Claire Huang <claire@luminahealth.com>
IT Admin: Linus Park <linus@luminahealth.com>

We confirm the suggested kickoff slot: 2028-08-17 09:00 PST. We do not need SSO on day 0; we'll use scoped API keys first and bring SSO online during week 1. For KMS, Lumina will provide the service principal by EOD today if needed.
